description: Bürgenstock is the resort locality on the cliff ridge above Lake Lucerne, in Nidwalden, mostly on the ground of Ennetbürgen and Stansstad rather than a municipality of its own. Hotels sit along the crest, the historic Hammetschwand lift is a thin shaft on the rock, and the lake lies far below with Pilatus across the water. No construction crane is added. The Open-Meteo model for this ridge cell is fully overcast, with soft light and no rain.
